answers.q1: Maven, using the checked-in wrapper (a Gradle build also exists, but CI's primary build and the pom.xml are Maven). Install dependencies with: ./mvnw -B dependency:go-offline (a plain ./mvnw -B compile also fetches them). Needs JDK 17+.
answers.q2: ./mvnw -B test (CI runs the full build including tests, format and checkstyle checks with: ./mvnw -B verify)
answers.q4: CI has no separate lint step. It runs ./mvnw -B verify, and the validate phase of that runs spring-javaformat:validate and the nohttp checkstyle check. To run only those two checks: ./mvnw -B validate. To auto-fix formatting: ./mvnw spring-javaformat:apply
answers.q5: target/ (Maven build output), build/ and .gradle/ (Gradle output), and any generated *.css under src/main/resources/static/resources/css (compiled from the SCSS by libsass; gitignored except petclinic.css). Edit the SCSS sources instead. There are no vendored directories. The wrapper files (mvnw, mvnw.cmd, gradlew, gradlew.bat, .mvn/wrapper/, gradle/wrapper/) are tool-generated and shouldn't be hand-edited.
